# Third-party source

`stb/stb_truetype.h` is version 1.26 from `nothings/stb` master commit
`2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`. Its SHA-256 digest is
`ecd30b05e0dd4fea3a13c26810dd9e1992dc379049482c393d5a19e6b5090aab`.

The file carries its upstream dual public-domain/MIT license text. It parses
only the trusted fonts embedded at build time; the camera never passes an
external or user-supplied font to the rasterizer.
